slot.brief: Solve a homogeneous dy/dx = f(y/x) by substituting y = vx; separate variables and integrate to get the general solution.

stem: The general solution of the differential equation $\frac{dy}{dx}=1+\frac{y^2}{x^2}$ is

verdicts.working: Set v=y/x, so y'=v+xv'. Then dv/(v²−v+1)=dx/x, yielding (2/√3) arctan((2v−1)/√3)=ln|x|+C. Rearranging gives option A.

working:
Set $y=vx$, so $\frac{dy}{dx}=v+x\frac{dv}{dx}$.
$x\frac{dv}{dx}=v^2-v+1$.
$\frac{dv}{(v-\frac12)^2+\frac34}=\frac{dx}{x}$.
$\frac{2}{sqrt{3}}\tan^{-1}\frac{2v-1}{sqrt{3}}=ln|x|+C$.
Substitute $v=\frac{y}{x}$ and rearrange to obtain option A.
